setupChecklist: Create a dataset for this clinic in the Effect's own Events Manager, or reuse an existing Pixel of theirs.
Share the dataset with the client's ad account.
On that dataset: Settings → Conversions API → Generate access token. Copy it once — Meta does not store it.
Fill in the dataset ID, token, Page ID and test event code below.
Qualify one real ad-originated deal and watch it appear in Events Manager → Test Events.
Clear the test event code. Only then do events count for optimization.
In Ads Manager, set the ad set's performance goal to this event name, with conversion location WhatsApp.
